description:
A minimal game launcher with a twist

Arcade

Arcade is a minimal, Material You-themed game launcher. It allows you to block offline games from accessing the internet using Shizuku or a VPN. This saves battery, blocks ads, and protects your privacy.

Features

  • Distraction free launcher letting you focus on your library, with clean Material design
  • Block selected games from accessing the network
  • Rename games
  • Automatically enable or disable Do Not Disturb for selected games
  • Organize your library by sorting games into groups
